items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: They used to dump on Brubeck because he got his picture in Time.

ctx.x: I know, and then they dump on people like Doc Severinsen or whoever, who have found a way to play music and become well-to-do.
Yeah. They used to dump on Brubeck because he got his picture in Time.
Yeah. And he was just playing, and continues to do, to play what he wants.
